columns_never_fillable.reason: MPACT discloses NPI only at Group level, not per property. The Portfolio Statement gives per-property gross revenue, occupancy and valuation but no per-property NPI.

Areas (GLA/NLA/GFA) are not disclosed per property in the audited Portfolio Statement; the Properties-at-a-Glance cards give NLA narratively only for some assets — not a clean per-property field across the portfolio.
Per-property tenant lists are not tabulated; only a portfolio-level Top Ten Tenants by GRI is disclosed (captured in top_tenants).

data_with_no_home: The Pinnacle Gangnam (South Korea): held via 50% effective interest as a joint venture; equity-accounted at Investment in a joint venture S$110,874k. NOT in the Portfolio Statement. MPACT shares profit after tax based on 50% effective interest; FY24/25 share of JV profit S$8,852k. 29 tenants.
Number of leases (portfolio): 959 tenants across the portfolio; 1,173 total leases (lease expiry profile bars).
Solar energy generated: 4,547 MWh renewable energy.
Proportion of fixed rate debt: 79.9% as at 31 Mar 2025.
Gross debt outstanding S$6,139.9m (incl. NCI share and proportionate JV gross debt).
Turnover (GTO) rental for the year: Group S$14,494k; MPACT S$11,191k.
Staff costs S$30,705k relate to Festival Walk employees + reimbursements to Property Managers; the trust/MPACT is otherwise externally managed (no payroll).
parsing_traps: Portfolio Statement uses a FACING-PAGE POSITIONAL SPLIT: property-name/tenure/location table on pages 116/118/120, and the value table (gross revenue / occupancy / valuation, blank first column) on the facing pages 117/119/121. Rows are aligned by position only. Routed properties to llm_only (positional pairing read directly from the markdown). Verified row-by-row against the audited sub-totals.

Statement of Profit or Loss prints both Group and MPACT (trust-only) columns side by side. Canonical = Group (consolidated) column. MPACT-only column (e.g. gross revenue 456,772; includes S$814.2m impairment of investment in subsidiary) is NOT used.
income_taxes is a tax CREDIT of S$6,113k in FY24/25 (negative expense): stored SIGNED negative in income_stmt_metrics; in line_items the adjustment is +6,113k (credit increases total return).

reconciliation.valuation_note: Σ of 18 Portfolio-Statement property valuations = S$15,728,702k = audited Group Investment properties line (SFP Note 14). The Pinnacle Gangnam (50% JV) is equity-accounted and correctly excluded from the Portfolio Statement total.
reconciliation.gross_revenue_note: Σ of 19 per-property gross revenue rows (incl. divested Mapletree Anson S$12,185k partial-year) = S$908,841k = Group gross revenue. (The Pinnacle Gangnam JV revenue is not consolidated.)
reconciliation.npi_note: Per-property NPI not disclosed; Group NPI S$683,537k captured in performance/financial.
